subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 8.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**like**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, we need to use a **preposition**. Prepositions are used link nouns or pronouns etc in the sentence.
 
• We often use **like **to give examples in a sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** We need to include foods that are rich in protein like eggs and nuts.
 
 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2**

**The complete passage is-** *The air has become very dirty in **(1) many** parts of the world. This is of course **(2) harmful** to your health. Experts say many people die** (3) from** it each year. There is a new study on **(4) air** pollution which comes from the experts of the World Health Organization (WHO) **(5) which** is an agency of the United Nations. If you **(6) inhale** unhealthy air for long periods of time, you could **(7) become** sick. Air pollution has been linked to many diseases **(8) like** stroke and cancer. The WHO says that seven million **(9) people** die each year as a result of the **(10) polluted** air.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **Hint__**

 
• In order to check whether we have used like correctly(for giving example) in a sentence. We can replace it with for example in the sentence as it conveys the same meaning.
